design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (community_rules_and_site_care_charges).
DRAW (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[6, 6, 5]. Assigned: self-help 6, repeat-violation 6, reinstatement payment 5.
SCOPE: task 0 occupies the vehicle permit fee, the registration-year fee and the past-due payment (enrolled records); task 1 claims self-help, repeat-violation and the reinstatement of suspended services with tools post_self_help_charge_892a63af, post_repeat_violation_charge_7b5daab9, pay_plan_reinstatement_3e360d67.
WHY A GOOD TEST: a suspended resident asks what to pay to get the crew back. The reinstatement policy waits on complete self-help and repeat-violation entries; the June lawn notice, cured by the community on 2026-06-30, carries neither. The agent prices the self-help cure from contract rates (lot, market, overgrowth days, edging, administration fee recurrence and courtesy), discovers the repeat charge itself waits on the self-help charge, prices it (class weight, cure cost, lapse, recurrence of resolved notices, tenure cap, courtesy) and then the 5-factor reinstatement payment.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD: root rules_ext_reinstatement_payment. Edges (state form, value_input): root -> self-help 'A reinstatement payment is quoted only after every violation notice that the community cured itself carries its self-help charge on the statement.'; root -> repeat 'A reinstatement payment is not quoted until every repeat notice in a community permitting repeat charges carries its repeat-violation charge on the statement.'; repeat -> self-help 'The repeat-violation charge on a notice is fixed only once each community cure on the plan record has its self-help charge posted.'. Only the self-help tool writes self-help entries and only the repeat tool writes repeat entries. Order self-help, repeat, reinstatement. Deletion sensitivity: skip self-help -> payment 443.50, repeat 92.00; skip repeat -> payment 436.50; gold 143.75 / 105.00 / 515.25.
FACTOR CARD: self-help 143.75 (baselines {'lot_size_scaling': 116.75, 'contract_market_scaling': 153.75, 'overgrowth_billing': 111.75, 'edging_addition': 128.75, 'administration_fee_recurrence': 128.75, 'administration_fee_courtesy': 155.0, '__all__': 75.0}); repeat 105.00 ({'rule_class_weighting': 98.0, 'cure_cost_addition': 77.0, 'cure_lapse_addition': 96.0, 'cure_recurrence_addition': 89.0, 'tenure_cap': 107.0, 'repeat_charge_tenure_courtesy': 140.0, '__all__': 50.0}); reinstatement 515.25 ({'lapse_advance': 473.25, 'returned_payment_reinstatement_advance': 431.25, 'upkeep_deferral': 666.25, 'repeat_charge_deferral': 541.5, 'balance_tolerance': 525.25, '__all__': 576.5}). Cross-difficulty evidence: lease_holdings and the 2026-02-04 return (2024-10-04 near-miss).
NO STAMP: the May cure's row carries contractor cost 141.00 and total 159.75 (17 days late, two visits, first self-help), not the scored 110.00 / 143.75.
TRAPS: counting the withdrawn 2025-08-19 notice (sequence or recurrence); copying the May self-help row; pricing the repeat charge before the self-help (gives 92.00); quoting only March and April plan fees.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: self-help governed by rules_agg_charge_attribution (policy_scope) and rules_self_help_terms (time gate cure_deadline_passed: anchor 2026-06-15, 7 days, exclusive; work 2026-06-30; suspended so the item is the resident's); repeat by attribution and rules_repeat_violation_terms (permitting community; earlier notice cured; withdrawn notices excluded from sequence and recurrence alike); payment by attribution and rules_charge_billing. The record is suspended (2026-03-01 fee unpaid 60 days on 2026-04-30), so the reinstatement policy applies, not the enrolled-only past-due policy.
PERSONA: warm, slightly embarrassed; phone to locate, SSN last four and date of birth to confirm identity; pays herself from checking; passive reactions only.
STANDARD SOLUTION: reads 0-6; post self-help 143.75 (contractor 110.00); post repeat 105.00; hand over; Yolanda pays 515.25 online_portal_ach. Verified by replaying the gold writes with the real tools; history rows evaluated with the same policies as of their own dates.
REVISIONS: round 2 (audit) — T1-1 May cure moved to 2026-06-05 (17 days late) so its contractor cost differs from the scored one; F-3 recurrence addition now counts resolved outcomes (cured by resident or community) so withdrawn notices are never counted, agreeing with the inherited base sentence; O-2 resumption wording; O-4 combination sentences quoted; T1-3/T1-4 persona wording.
user_scenario: You are Yolanda M. Ybarra, fifty-seven, a school cafeteria manager in Conroe who has lived on site 514 at Bluebonnet Ridge since 2018 with your husband and your teenage son, plus a dog named Pepper and a cat named Mochi. You are warm, a little talkative and slightly embarrassed: this spring your bank account was changed after a fraud scare, a couple of payments slipped, and now the lawn crew has stopped coming. You're calling because I'd like my lawn service turned back on, and I need to know what to pay to get it going again. You will pay it yourself, from your checking account, today; you are not asking for anything to be waived. When the representative asks who you are, you give your phone number 936-555-0193; when they ask you to confirm your identity you give the last four of your Social Security number, 5561, and then your date of birth, November 21, 1968, which you repeat as 1968-11-21 if they want it in numbers. You don't know any account or reference numbers. If asked whether anything was done about the yard while the service was off, you say you think a crew came by at some point but you don't know what it cost or whether anything is on your statement. If the representative says something has to be put on your statement before they can give you the figure, you sigh and say that's fair, if it's owed then go ahead. If they ask whether you still have two cars, you say yes. You never suggest how anything should be worked out; if a figure surprises you, you only ask them to check it against your account. When the representative hands you the payment to make, you make it yourself from your checking account and read the confirmation number back. Once you have the confirmation number you thank them, say you hope the crew comes back next week, and end the call.
